name: gist-artifacts
description: Publish, update and share pages as Gist Artifacts: versioned GitHub Gists with a shareable viewer link.

interface.shortDescription: Publish pages as versioned GitHub Gists with a shareable link
interface.longDescription: Turn the reports, visualizations and interactive pages you build into Gist Artifacts. Each artifact is a GitHub Gist you own, with a small manifest; every update is a Git revision, and a viewer link makes it easy to share, pin, fork and comment on.
